description: This file is a header file for nedalloc, an alternative memory allocator implementation in C. It declares functions, macros, and structures related to memory allocation, deallocation, and pool management, with some configurable options.

methods.name: nedblksize
methods.description: Returns the usable size of an allocated memory block.

methods.name: nedsetvalue
methods.description: Sets a value to be associated with a specific memory block.

methods.name: nedmalloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of the specified size.

methods.name: nedcalloc
methods.description: Allocates and zero-initializes an array.

methods.name: nedrealloc
methods.description: Resizes an allocated memory block.

methods.name: nedfree
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: nedmemalign
methods.description: Allocates memory with a specific alignment.

methods.name: nedmallinfo
methods.description: Returns information about memory allocation.

methods.name: nedmallopt
methods.description: Adjusts mallopt parameters.

methods.name: nedmalloc_trim
methods.description: Attempts to trim malloc memory to reduce footprint.

methods.name: nedmalloc_stats
methods.description: Outputs statistics about memory allocation.

methods.name: nedmalloc_footprint
methods.description: Returns the total footprint of malloc memory.

methods.name: nedindependent_calloc
methods.description: Allocates multiple blocks, similar to calloc, with independent chunks.

methods.name: nedindependent_comalloc
methods.description: Allocates multiple chunks with specified sizes.

methods.name: nedcreatepool
methods.description: Creates a memory pool for alloc/dealloc cycles.

methods.name: neddestroypool
methods.description: Destroys a previously created memory pool.

methods.name: nedpsetvalue
methods.description: Associates a value with a memory pool.

methods.name: nedgetvalue
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a memory block or pool.

methods.name: neddisablethreadcache
methods.description: Disables thread cache for a pool.

methods.name: nedpmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory from a specific pool.

methods.name: nedpcalloc
methods.description: Allocates and zero-initializes from a pool.

methods.name: nedprealloc
methods.description: Resizes a pool-allocated memory block.

methods.name: nedpfree
methods.description: Frees a memory block from a pool.

methods.name: nedpmemalign
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory from a pool.

methods.name: nedpmallinfo
methods.description: Returns info about memory used by a pool.

methods.name: nedpmallopt
methods.description: Adjusts parameters for pool memory management.

methods.name: nedpmalloc_trim
methods.description: Trims memory used by a pool.

methods.name: nedpindependent_calloc
methods.description: Pool version of independent_calloc.

methods.name: nedpindependent_comalloc
methods.description: Pool version of independent_comalloc.
